item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs dbang chen ngo mtshar rgyas pa'i bsgrub pa
item.coloph: g.yung skabs kyi stod khrig las/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i thabs/ tshogs las rgya mtsho bstan pa 'di/ phyi rabs 'gro ba'i don ched du/ 'chi med gtsug phud thugs bcud phyung*/ rdzu 'phrul gshen po rim bzhin brgyud/ stong chen thugs kyis yang bcud bon/ phyi rabs las ldan gshen la brgyud//
